student_learning_goal: I can write code, plant a bug, and check my partner's fix.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can write code, plant a bug, and check my partner's fix.
header.character_watermark: Buzz and Patch together in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall combined).

image_placeholders.description: A 2-lane code area in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. Header 'Part 1: My Code'. 6-row 2-lane template.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P1_CODE: keywords (my, code) name the area.

parts.answer_key: Open. Must have 2 lanes and at least 4 time-steps.

parts.student_instructions: Plant ONE bug. Mark the expected outcome.

image_placeholders.description: A bug slot in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1.5in. 'My bug at step ___'. 'Expected outcome: ___'. Header 'Part 2: Plant a Bug'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P2_BUG: keywords (bug) name the slot.

parts.student_instructions: Swap with a partner. Find their bug. Fix it. Verify.

image_placeholders.description: A partner fix area in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1.5in. 'Partner's bug: ___'. 'My fix: ___'. 'Verified: ___'. Header 'Part 3: Partner Fix'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P3_PARTNER: keywords (partner) name the area.

parts.student_instructions: Which bug type was easiest to find?

image_placeholders.description: A reflection box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1.5in. 'Easiest bug type: ___'. 'Why: ___'. Header 'Part 4: Reflection'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P4_REFLECT: keywords (reflection) name the box.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, plant a SECOND bug for your partner.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone. Watch for no-bug-plant trap.
